## Summary

Ran the full NIMBUS Step 0–5 pipeline directly (flat topology, no subagent delegation) for all 5 requested endpoints. Confirmed via `detect-external-calls` that none of the 5 endpoints make external HTTP calls under default config, so **no WireMock stubs were needed anywhere**. `analyze-auth-flow` confirmed no interceptors exist in the project.

**Generated artifacts** (all passed Step 5 static validation):

| Endpoint | Test class | Methods (NTC/ATC/VTC) |
|---|---|---|
| POST /api/v1/auth/guest | `AuthGuestBlackBoxTest.java` | 3/1/0 |
| POST /api/v1/auth/login | `AuthLoginBlackBoxTest.java` | 4/3/6 |
| POST /internal/auth/verify | `AuthVerifyBlackBoxTest.java` | 3/1/3 |
| GET /internal/users/{id} | `UsersGetBlackBoxTest.java` | 3/1/6 |
| GET /api/v1/me | `MeGetBlackBoxTest.java` | 3/3/4 |

Each endpoint also has self-contained setup/teardown SQL in `src/test/resources/sql/`. DB verification uses direct JDBC, Redis verification uses raw Lettuce (no Spring beans), and all assertions use exact matchers (`equalTo`, `matchesPattern` for dynamic values) — no `anyOf()` or loose matchers.

Wrote `.nimbus/artifacts/manifest.json` (all 5 endpoints `status: ok`) and one orchestrator line to `diagnostics/run_ledger_layerA.jsonl` per the flat-mode instrumentation rule (delegations=0, stage epochs in notes). Per scope restrictions, I did not run `mvn test`/`mvn verify`, did not start Docker/DB/server, and did not build the Pre-Step docker infrastructure (out of the requested "tests + SQL + WireMock" deliverable scope). Also updated project memory with the completed design and key gotchas for future sessions.
